name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: A small set of exclusive choices: 16px circles that turn brand blue around a blue dot when chosen.
usage: Pick one of two to five options that should all stay visible (an output format, a region, a plan). Pair each RadioGroupItem with a Label by htmlFor; arrow keys move the choice. For longer lists use Select; for an on or off setting use Switch.
avoid: Radio buttons for settings that apply at once
A radio group with nothing chosen when one option is the default

reference.source: Extrapolated from context-dashboard c0ddf7a src/components/ui/form.tsx (the checkbox and field terms: the 16px box, strong hairline and brand blue)
reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
